title: Document the engine installer and version contract
summary: The engine repository's README and CHANGELOG describe the one-command engine installer, the launcher and PATH behaviour, uninstall, the machine-readable version, and how the version a configured source or ref provides is obtained and compared.
plan_goal: Make Forgel and Forgel Code install and run as one working pair: give the engine `forgel` its own installer, add a mode of the Forgel Code installer that installs both binaries together (offered by default in the README, idempotent — when the engine is already present it compares versions and installs only a strictly newer one), and introduce a declared minimum supported engine version for Forgel Code, checked at startup, so a missing or too-old engine produces a clear actionable message instead of `engine forgel: executable not found: forgel`.

result.summary: stopped by the controller: The documentation task is sound but has an unmet prerequisite that this task cannot create. The failure is not a specification defect (the spec explicitly requires documenting only shipped behaviour), not a repository test or environment problem, and not a limit; the earlier decisions — respec, retry, two reworks, restart, QA, and a raised limit — have all exhausted the space of re-runs, and each returned the same fact: the engine has no installer, entry point on PATH, profile/reachability handling, uninstall path, or pre-install version determination. The only shipped piece is the version inquiry, so FR-1, FR-2, FR-3, FR-5, FR-6, FR-7 and their acceptance criteria cannot be met truthfully, and writing them anyway would break FR-8/AC-8. The plan's backlog item 2, which must implement the installer, is itself marked blocked (dependency scout exceeded its step limit), and the escalated install.sh/test_install.py from an earlier attempt were never committed. Re-running this task unchanged reproduces the same conclusion; no runtime next-step operation can retarget the prerequisite task from here. The work must stop with this reason so the plan sequencing is corrected: unblock and implement the engine installer task, then re-queue this documentation task against the shipped behaviour.
